node.label: Energy security & renewables
node.summary: Oil, LNG, renewable energy and the effect of the West Asia war.

facts.text: Russia's LNG exports rose **13.4%** to 28 million tonnes (Jan-Oct 2026), helped by the **Arctic LNG 2** project.
facts.plain: Russia's LNG exports rose 13.4% to 28 million tonnes (Jan-Oct 2026), helped by the Arctic LNG 2 project.

facts.text: PM: clean energy cushioned India from the West Asia crisis. Next push: storage, indigenous solar hardware, solar in farming, and solar on government buildings.
facts.plain: PM: clean energy cushioned India from the West Asia crisis. Next push: storage, indigenous solar hardware, solar in farming, and solar on government buildings.

facts.text: PM Modi opened the **Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo 2026**; India's renewable sector offers about **$220 billion** in investment opportunities by 2030.
facts.plain: PM Modi opened the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo 2026; India's renewable sector offers about $220 billion in investment opportunities by 2030.

facts.text: India's power consumption grew **21.88% y-o-y in October to 159.76 billion units**, while Coal India Ltd's production rose 19.3% y-o-y to 67.2 million tonnes.
facts.plain: India's power consumption grew 21.88% y-o-y in October to 159.76 billion units, while Coal India Ltd's production rose 19.3% y-o-y to 67.2 million tonnes.
keys: 21.88% y-o-y in October to 159.76 billion units

facts.text: India's installed solar capacity grew from **2.8 GW (2014) to 171 GW**, with solar tariffs falling from about ₹8/unit to as low as ₹2.15/unit; under PM Surya Ghar, 21+ lakh of a 65-lakh-home target now have zero electricity bills; the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit (Bharat Mandapam, 2-5 Nov) hosts the 9th ISA Assembly and the 4th International Conference on Green Hydrogen, with India targeting $220 billion in investment for 500 GW of non-fossil capacity by 2030.
facts.plain: India's installed solar capacity grew from 2.8 GW (2014) to 171 GW, with solar tariffs falling from about ₹8/unit to as low as ₹2.15/unit; under PM Surya Ghar, 21+ lakh of a 65-lakh-home target now have zero electricity bills; the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit (Bharat Mandapam, 2-5 Nov) hosts the 9th ISA Assembly and the 4th International Conference on Green Hydrogen, with India targeting $220 billion in investment for 500 GW of non-fossil capacity by 2030.

facts.text: Commercial LPG prices rose for a third straight time (Delhi 19-kg cylinder up ₹10 to ₹2,820; Kolkata saw the steepest hike of ₹17 to ₹2,971) and ATF (jet fuel) rose ₹1.37/litre to ₹138.5 — the fourth hike since July — while domestic LPG prices were left unchanged.
facts.plain: Commercial LPG prices rose for a third straight time (Delhi 19-kg cylinder up ₹10 to ₹2,820; Kolkata saw the steepest hike of ₹17 to ₹2,971) and ATF (jet fuel) rose ₹1.37/litre to ₹138.5 — the fourth hike since July — while domestic LPG prices were left unchanged.

facts.text: India imported **209.4 lakh tonnes** of crude in Sept 2026; the import bill of **$14.3 billion** was 33% higher than a year earlier. Russia and the UAE together supply **60%** of India's oil.
facts.plain: India imported 209.4 lakh tonnes of crude in Sept 2026; the import bill of $14.3 billion was 33% higher than a year earlier. Russia and the UAE together supply 60% of India's oil.

facts.text: After the US **'Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026'** (signed **18 Sept**; allows tariffs of up to **100%** on buyers of Russian oil, waived by Trump on 16 Oct), India cut **US oil imports to zero** in September and Russia's share fell from a record **51% (July)** to **33%**; the **UAE** now supplies over a quarter.
